answer: Stop sybils with a mesa terrace, a vine graft, and an inlet. Each identity climbs the mesa one level per clean epoch, posting a fresh bond at every level, and each bond is a vine grafted onto its funder root, so grafts from one purse share one root. The inlet admits one graft at a time and forces a cascade: when the k-th graft enters, every graft on that root must top up its bond by one base unit, so N clones post 1+2+...+N bonds, about N squared, for a single shared mesa share. One honest agent climbs alone and pays one bond per level; a clone factory pays quadratic bonds for one terrace.
